about: Single source of truth for AI-generated art (ChatGPT web). The import script (tools/import_art.py) reads this to validate, rename, optimize and place every downloaded image. Keep it in sync with game.js: CITIES (cities + nightZones), THEMES (background seam), SPRITE_SRC (sprite seam). Adding a city/sprite = add a defaults-shaped entry here, write its prompt in prompts/chatgpt_image_batches.md, regenerate.

art_direction.style: Flat clean illustration, Survivors.io-grade polish. Bold simple shapes, limited flat color fills, soft cel shading, thin restrained dark outlines on characters only. NOT painterly, NOT photoreal, NOT pixel-art, NOT 3D render.
art_direction.palette_intent: Warm, saturated Indian street-food palette for FOOD/HERO; the world recedes (muted, slightly desaturated) so gameplay objects pop. Night zones cool down but keep warm lamp pools.
art_direction.readability_law: This is a top-down survivors-like. Backgrounds must read as a calm, low-contrast surface a grey enemy and a bright food token can sit ON TOP of and remain instantly legible. Busy, high-contrast, or noisy art that hides a grey blob = reject.
art_direction.consistency: All assets in a batch share one art direction so the cities feel like one game. Same outline weight, same shading logic, same horizon/lighting language across a city's day+night pair.
art_direction.forbidden_global: No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI, frames/borders, or signage with readable words. No real brand marks. No body-shape/health/diet messaging of any kind (hard brand rule).

background.fit: cover-crop (game cover-fits the master to the 9:16 arena; safe-zone the scene so cropping the sides/top loses nothing critical)

prop.fit: engine pins this transparent strip to BOTH real arena edges and tiles it to height (game.js drawCityEdges) — no crop on any device aspect. Trimmed to the prop bbox on import; transparency preserved.

assets.level_scope: MUMBAI day zones (1-3 & 5) — tiled down both curbs
assets.scene: A single TALL NARROW VERTICAL COLUMN of Mumbai street-food curb props on a FULLY TRANSPARENT background, top-down: a blue-tarp chaiwala stall, a wooden vada-pav cart, a crate of oranges and greens, a green/yellow auto-rickshaw, a red-striped-awning snack stall, a clay matka pot, a black-and-yellow Padmini taxi. Evenly spaced down one column with small gaps. NO road/ground — only the objects and a soft contact shadow under each. The game tiles this strip down BOTH real arena edges.
assets.mood_lighting: Warm overcast monsoon daylight, soft diffuse contact shadows. Muted so it recedes behind gameplay.
assets.readability: Each prop reads clearly at ~120px wide in-game. Bold simple shapes, soft cel shading. Transparent everywhere except the props + their contact shadow.
assets.style: Flat clean illustration, Survivors.io polish. Warm Mumbai palette (terracotta + teal + mustard accents). Soft cel shading, restrained outlines.
assets.negative: NO road/ground/pavement/kerb fill (the game draws the road). NO background — must be transparent. No people. No text/signs-with-words/logos/watermarks. No hazards. No frame/border. Do not spread props horizontally — keep one vertical column.
acceptance: Single vertical column of Mumbai curb props on a TRANSPARENT background (has alpha)
No road/ground baked in — only props + soft contact shadows
Reads as Mumbai (taxi / stalls / rickshaw / matka) at a glance
Aspect ~2:3, short edge >= 512px, transparent, no text/logos/people

assets.scene: A single chibi Indian street-food courier, 'The Tiffin Runner'. Steep three-quarter top-down view (seen slightly from above and front, matching a survivors-like). Big head, small body (chibi, reads at small size). Red delivery cap with a saffron band, dark hair peeking out, warm brown skin, mustard shirt, tied cream apron (neck straps + waist bow + pocket), navy trousers. Holds a small 2-tier steel tiffin/dabba at the side (kept SMALL, must not dominate). Friendly, plucky. Facing toward the viewer / slightly down-screen.
assets.mood_lighting: Bright, warm, even lighting. Vibrant and saturated so the hero pops against muted streets. Soft single drop of cel shading.
assets.readability: Must read clearly at ~50px tall in-game. Bold silhouette, thin dark outline, minimal interior detail. Centered in frame with even margins.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration, Survivors.io-grade. Bold simple shapes, thin dark outline, flat fills + one soft shade. Chibi proportions.
assets.negative: NO background, NO scene, NO ground, NO shadow on ground — fully TRANSPARENT background. No text/logo. No oversized props (tiffin stays small). No multiple characters. No weapon. No extra limbs. Not cropped — whole character with margin. No drop shadow baked in.
acceptance: Single centered chibi courier on transparent background (has alpha)
Cap + apron + small tiffin all present and correctly proportioned (tiffin small)
Bold readable silhouette at small scale
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene

assets.level_scope: The Bland grunt (standard enemy, all cities)
assets.scene: A single 'Bland' — a smug grey lumpy blob creature. Fully desaturated grey (the anti-flavor). Smug face: angled brows, low beady pupils, a smug closed mouth with a tiny tongue, a couple of small drips. Slightly cute, love-to-hate. Standing, facing viewer. Chibi, simple.
assets.mood_lighting: Flat, slightly dull lighting — it is the colour-draining enemy, so it stays grey and matte while everything else is warm.
assets.readability: Must read as a distinct grey threat at ~40px against both warm day and dark night streets. Bold rounded silhouette, thin dark outline, clear face. Centered with margin.
assets.style: Flat clean mascot illustration matching the courier's outline/shading language, but fully grey and desaturated.
assets.negative: NO background/scene/ground — fully TRANSPARENT. No colour (keep it grey/desaturated). No text/logo. No multiple blobs. Not cropped. No baked ground shadow.
acceptance: Single centered grey smug blob on transparent background (has alpha)
Desaturated grey, clear smug face, readable silhouette at small scale
Aspect ~1:1, short edge >= 768px, transparent, no text/scene
